description: This source file implements an asynchronous signal executor using a thread-based approach. It contains functions for scheduling callbacks with delays, particularly for sleep/wake operations in a firmware context related to engine control.

classes.name: SleepExecutor
classes.description: A class implementing asynchronous signal scheduling, primarily for sleep and wake events in the firmware.

methods.name: scheduleByTimestamp
methods.description: Schedules an event to occur at a specific timestamp, calculating the delay relative to current time.

methods.name: scheduleForLater
methods.description: Schedules an event to occur after a specified delay in microseconds.
